Description
This gorgeous
gold bar
is the perfect way to celebrate Diwali, the festival of lights! The Hindu community’s most significant event is called Diwali. This gold bar commemorates Lakshmi, one of the most revered deities of Diwali. Lakshmi is a representation of beauty, wealth, and success. She is also referred to as Gaj Laxmi, the Goddess of Elephants, and is thought to represent fertility and strength. The year and name of the celebration are printed on the 5 gram PAMP Suisse Diwali Lakshmi Gold Bar, which is enclosed in a themed, ornamental sleeve.
The 5 gram PAMP Suisse Diwali Lakshmi Gold Bar (in Assay) is available at
Bullion Trading LLC
for you to purchase! Each bar, struck by PAMP Suisse, has 5 grams of .9999 pure gold in it. Individually serialized bars are delivered in assay cards that are made to order. Each Assay card includes Lakshi and Diwali artwork, including elephants, floating lanterns, and vibrant colors. Only 5000 pieces of these 5 gram PAMP Suisse Diwali Lakshmi Gold Bars will only be made, so act immediately to secure yours!
Design of 5 gram PAMP Suisse Diwali Lakshmi Gold Bar
The obverse side of the 5 gram PAMP Suisse Diwali Lakshmi gold bar features the PAMP Suisse logo, assay mark, and other inscriptions. The reverse side of this gold bar features the goddess Lakshmi sitting within a Lotus flower with lanterns and inscriptions overhead.
Main Highlights of 5 gram PAMP Suisse Diwali Lakshmi Gold Bar
Limited mintage of only 5,000 bars!
Individually serialized
Produced by
MKS PAMP
exclusively for MTB
Weighs 5 grams.9999 pure gold.
Enclosed in a vibrantly colored CertiPAMP assay card with a matching envelope.
Obverse: Shows the serial number, the PAMP Suisse emblem, the assay mark, the words “SUISSE,” “5 g,” “FINE GOLD,” and “999.9.”
Reverse: Displays Lakshmi sitting inside a lotus flower, with the words “DIWALI” and “FESTIVAL OF LIGHTS” written in lanterns above her.
